stages.reference: Create a close material reference for an extraordinary solid mass of diamond material in a grounded dark-fantasy game world. It should feel impossibly valuable and physically hard without becoming jewelry: densely fused crystalline carbon with interlocking translucent facets, internal strain, pale mineral inclusions and restrained cyan-blue body color caused by depth rather than neon paint. Light should break subtly within the mass while the exterior remains game-material readable. Avoid cut gemstones, mirror polish, glitter, magical glow, chrome-like reflections or plastic turquoise. Establish a severe mineral richness—cold, dense, crystalline and ancient—appropriate to a building block rather than an ornament.
